name: Wellness to Work
whoFor: Kirklees residents aged 18 and over with a health condition or disability affecting their ability to get or keep a job.
locations: Princess Royal Health Centre, Greenhead Rd, Huddersfield HD1 4EW
Batley Health Centre, 130 Upper Commercial St, Batley WF17 5ED
Dewsbury Health Centre, Wellington Road, Dewsbury WF13 1HN
eligibility: Aged 18 or over, living in Kirklees, with a health condition or disability affecting ability to get or keep a job
Out of work due to ill health, OR in work but at risk of falling out of work due to ill health (including musculoskeletal conditions and/or vocational rehabilitation needs)
Committed to remaining in or entering paid employment

activities.name: Wellness to Work
activities.summary: A personalised holistic assessment of barriers (health, confidence, skills, general wellbeing), clinical triage where needed, and a dedicated Employment Navigator and health professional who build an action plan. Includes MSK fast-track physiotherapy and occupational therapy vocational rehabilitation. Connects people to partners such as Get Set Goal, Kirklees Active Leisure, Kirklees College and Third Sector Leaders.
activities.duration: 3-6 months, with coordination for up to 3 months afterwards, plus in-work support for people who get a job

provenance.source: Kirklees HWL Pathways Aug 26 v2.1 (draft 15 Sept 2026; grant-funded schemes added 12 Oct 2026)
